title: Generate baselines
text: Figure 1: Baseline values hard corals.
code: ## ---- SyntheticData_Spatial.mesh mesh <- synthos::create_spde_mesh(spatial_grid,config_sp)  ## Synthetic Baselines ---------------------------------------------------- spatial.grid.pts.df <- spatial_grid %>%   st_coordinates() %>%   as.data.frame() %>%   dplyr::rename(Longitude = X, Latitude = Y) %>%   arrange(Longitude, Latitude)  ## ---- SyntheticData_BaselineSpatial.HCC  cover_range <- config_sp$hcc_cover_range cover_range <- qlogis(cover_range)  baseline.sample.hcc <- mesh$loc[,1:2] %>%   as.data.frame() %>%   dplyr::select(Longitude = V1, Latitude = V2) %>%   mutate(clong = as.vector(scale(Longitude, scale = FALSE)),          clat = as.vector(scale(Latitude, scale = FALSE)),          Y = clong + sin(clat) +             1.5*clong + clat) %>%   mutate(Y = scales::rescale(Y, to = cover_range))  baseline.effects.hcc <- baseline.sample.hcc %>%   dplyr::select(Y) %>%   as.matrix baseline.pts.sample.hcc <- inla.mesh.project(mesh,                                              loc=as.matrix(spatial.grid.pts.df [,1:2]),                                              baseline.effects.hcc) baseline.pts.effects.hcc = baseline.pts.sample.hcc %>%    cbind() %>%    as.matrix() %>%    as.data.frame() %>%   cbind(spatial.grid.pts.df ) %>%    pivot_longer(cols = c(-Longitude,-Latitude),                names_to = c('Year'),                names_pattern = 'sample:(.*)',                values_to = 'Value') %>%   mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year))  ggplot() +   geom_tile(     data = baseline.pts.effects.hcc,      aes(y = Latitude, x = Longitude, fill = 100 * plogis(Value))   ) +   geom_sf(     data = reefs.sf$simulated_reefs_sf,      fill = NA,      color = "black"   ) +   scico::scale_fill_scico(     "Coral cover (%)",     palette = "hawaii",           direction = 1,     limits = c(10, 60),             breaks = seq(10, 60, by = 20),     labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 1)   ) +   coord_sf(crs = 4326) +   xlab("Longitude") +    ylab("Latitude") +   theme_pubr() +   theme(     legend.position = "top",     legend.justification = c(0.5, 1),     legend.direction = "horizontal",     legend.text = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)   )

title: Generate Settings for Synthetic Reef Simulations — generateSettings
text: Creates saves configuration lists required simulate synthetic reef landscapes, including spatial, large-scale, fine-scale, point-based sampling parameters. configuration list also assigned global environment use downstream modelling functions. Spatio-temporal parameters (config_sp) seed: Random seed controlling stochastic processes. crs: Coordinate reference system (EPSG code) applied spatial domain. model: Variogram model used generate spatial covariance. Supported models include "Sph", "Exp", "Gau", "Lin", "Mat", "Ste", "Pen", "Hug", "Hol", "Cor", composite forms "Sphlin", "Sphexp", "Sphgaus", "Sphmat", "Sphste", "Sphpen", "Sphhug", "Sphhol", "Sphcor". psill: Partial sill. variance explained spatial structure; difference sill (asymptotic variance variogram) nugget. Represents plateau reached lag distance increases. range: Distance spatial correlation becomes negligible. Beyond range, locations effectively uncorrelated. nugget: Variance zero distance (variogram intercept). Captures measurement error micro-scale variability sampling resolution. alpha: Smoothness parameter spatial field. Larger values produce smoother fields; smaller values yield rugged surfaces. SPDE models, controls order differential operator. kappa: Controls spatial scale (range) SPDE spatial field. Smaller values correspond broader spatial correlation; larger values produce shorter-range correlation. variance: Variance parameter used construction Matérn precision matrix spatial field. patch\_threshold: Numeric cutoff spatial field masked, producing discrete habitat patches. reef\_width: Half-width reef "ribbon" used represent benthic habitat around patch outline. years: Sequence years included simulation. dhw\_weight: Weight determining relative influence degree heating weeks (thermal stress) benthic cover. cyc\_weight: Weight determining influence cyclone disturbances benthic cover. \_weight: Weight additional disturbances explicitly modelled. hcc\_cover\_range: Minimum maximum expected hard coral cover space time. hcc\_growth: Annual growth rate hard coral cover. sc\_cover\_range: Minimum maximum expected soft coral cover space time. sc\_growth: Annual growth rate soft coral cover. Large-scale sampling parameters (config_lrge) n_locs: Number reef locations. n_sites: Number sites per reef. seed: Seed sampling design reproducibility. Fine-scale sampling parameters (config_fine) (Site, transect, random-effect structure benthic group) years: Years included fine-scale simulation. Number_of_transects_per_site: Number transects simulated site. Depths: Number depth strata simulated. hcc_site_sigma, hcc_transect_sigma, hcc_sigma: Variances site-level, transect-level, residual random effects hard coral cover. sc_site_sigma, sc_transect_sigma, sc_sigma: Equivalent random-effect variances soft coral. ma_site_sigma, ma_transect_sigma, ma_sigma: Equivalent random-effect variances macroalgae. Point-based sampling parameters (config_pt) Defines photo-quadrat point-count structure. Depths: Number depth strata. Depth_effect_multiplier: Multiplier controlling depth-related differences benthic cover. Number_of_transects_per_site: Transects per site. Number_of_frames_per_transect: Number photo frames per transect. Number_of_quadrats_per_transect: Quadrat count per transect. Points_per_frame: Number random points per photographic frame. Quad_sigma: Random variation among quadrats.
